openers.text: Before we start: how are you actually doing, on a scale from fine to the truth?
What is one thing from today that you want to leave outside the door before we begin?
What do you want tonight to feel like when we hang up?

closers.text: One thing you learned about me tonight. One thing you learned about yourself.
Which answer tonight do you want me to remember?
What do you want to carry from this into tomorrow?

followUps.text: What made you remember that one?
Say the part you were about to skip.
What would you tell someone else in that situation?
What is the feeling underneath that?
What do you want me to do with that?
What is the version of that you tell other people?
What would make that easier to say?
What did you want me to say back?

daily.text: One thing that made today lighter.
The best thing you saw today.
A thought you had about me today, unedited.
Something you wanted to say today and did not.
What you are looking forward to tomorrow.
One thing you would have done differently today.
Something you ate that you want to tell me about.
A song for today, and why that one.
One word for today, then the reason.
A tiny win from today.
Something that annoyed you today that I would find funny.
Someone you talked to today that you want me to know about.
What you would want from me if I were there right now.
A photo from today and the story behind it.
Something you are worried about tonight.
What you did today that your younger self would be proud of.
The nicest thing anyone did for you today.
Something you learned today.
Where your mind went when it wandered today.
Something you are grateful for about us today.
The moment today you most wished I could see.
What tired you out today, and was it worth it?
A small kindness you did today that nobody noticed.
Something you noticed about yourself today.
What you want tomorrow to have more of.
One sentence you would text me at 3 a.m. if you were sure I was awake.
What you are proud of this week so far.
A sound from today.
What you would change about today if you could replay it.
The thing you are most looking forward to about the next time we are together.
